title: Simple Daily Habits to Keep Your Drains Flowing
description: Preventing blocked drains starts at the fixture before waste ever reaches your pipes. In kitchen sinks, food scraps, coffee grounds, and cooking grease are the primary causes of stubborn line clogs and P-trap buildup. Placing a fine stainless steel mesh strainer over your drain catches solid debris that would otherwise settle in your waste line. In bathrooms, hair catchers perform the same critical role. Avoid pouring fats, oils, or grease down any drain, as they congeal inside cooler pipe walls. Regular flushing with warm water helps keep lines clear, but catching solids at the surface remains the most effective defense against drain backups.
